text_en: My little children, I am writing these things to you so that you may not sin. But if anyone does sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous;
text_cn: 我的孩子们，我给你们写这些事，是为叫你们不犯罪；但是，谁若犯了罪，我们在父那里有正义的耶稣基督作护慰者。

text_en: and he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only but also for the sins of the whole world.
text_cn: 他自己就是赎罪祭，赎我们的罪过，不但赎我们的，而且也赎全世界的罪过。

text_en: Now by this we may be sure that we know him, if we obey his commandments.
text_cn: 如果我们遵守他的命令，由此便知道我们认识他。

text_en: Whoever says, “I have come to know him, ” but does not obey his commandments, is a liar, and in such a person the truth does not exist;
text_cn: 那说“我认识他”，而不遵守他命令的，是撒谎的人，在他内没有真理。

text_en: but whoever obeys his word, truly in this person the love of God has reached perfection. By this we may be sure that we are in him:
text_cn: 但是，谁若遵守他的话，天主的爱在他内才得以圆满；由此我们也知道，我们是在他内。

text_en: whoever says, “I abide in him, ” ought to walk just as he walked.
text_cn: 那说自己住在他内的，就应当照那一位所行的去行。

text_en: Beloved, I am writing you no new commandment, but an old commandment that you have had from the beginning; the old commandment is the word that you have heard.
text_cn: 可爱的诸位，我给你们写的，不是一条新命令，而是你们从起初领受的旧命令：这旧命令就是你们所听的道理。

text_en: Yet I am writing you a new commandment that is true in him and in you, because the darkness is passing away and the true light is already shining.
text_cn: 另一方面说，我给你们写的也是一条新命令──就是在他和你们身上成为事实的──因为黑暗正在消逝，真光已在照耀。

text_en: Whoever says, “I am in the light, ” while hating a brother or sister, is still in the darkness.
text_cn: 谁说自己在光中，而恼恨自己的弟兄，他至今仍是在黑暗中。

text_en: Whoever loves a brother or sister lives in the light, and in such a person there is no cause for stumbling.
text_cn: 凡爱自己弟兄的，就是存留在光中，对于他就没有任何绊脚石；

text_en: But whoever hates another believer is in the darkness, walks in the darkness, and does not know the way to go, because the darkness has brought on blindness.
text_cn: 但是恼恨自己弟兄的，就是在黑暗中，且在黑暗中行走，不知道自己往那里去，因为黑暗弄瞎了他的眼睛。

text_en: I am writing to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven on account of his name.
text_cn: 孩子们，我给你们写说：因他的名字，你们的罪已获得赦免。

text_en: I am writing to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I am writing to you, young people, because you have conquered the evil one.
text_cn: 父老们，我给你们写说：你们已认识了从起初就有的那一位。青年们，我给你们写说：你们已得胜了那恶者。

text_en: I write to you, children, because you know the Father. I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young people, because you are strong and the word of God abides in you, and you have overcome the evil one.
text_cn: 小孩子们，我给你们写过：你们已认识了父。父老们，我给你们写过：你们已认识了从起初就有的那一位。青年们，我给你们写过：你们是强壮的，天主的话存留在你们内，你们也得胜了那恶者。

text_en: Do not love the world or the things in the world. The love of the Father is not in those who love the world;
text_cn: 你们不要爱世界，也不要爱世界上的事；谁若爱世界，天父的爱就不在他内。

text_en: for all that is in the world—the desire of the flesh, the desire of the eyes, the pride in riches—comes not from the Father but from the world.
text_cn: 原来世界上的一切：肉身的贪欲，眼目的贪欲，以及人生的骄奢，都不是出于父，而是出于世界。

text_en: And the world and its desire are passing away, but those who do the will of God live forever.
text_cn: 这世界和它的贪欲都要过去；但那履行天主旨意的，却永远存在。

text_en: Children, it is the last hour! As you have heard that antichrist is coming, so now many antichrists have come. From this we know that it is the last hour.
text_cn: 小孩子们，现在是最末的时期了！就如你们听说过假基督要来，如今已经出了许多假基督，由此我们就知道现在是最末的时期了。

text_en: They went out from us, but they did not belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have remained with us. But by going out they made it plain that none of them belongs to us.
text_cn: 他们是出于我们中的，但不是属于我们的，因为，如果是属于我们的，必存留在我们中；但这是为显示他们都不是属于我们。

text_en: But you have been anointed by the Holy One, and all of you have knowledge.
text_cn: 至于你们，你们由圣者领受了傅油，并且你们都晓得。

text_en: I write to you, not because you do not know the truth, but because you know it, and you know that no lie comes from the truth.
text_cn: 我给你们写信，不是你们不明白真理，而是因为你们明白真理，并明白各种谎言不是出于真理。

text_en: Who is the liar but the one who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the antichrist, the one who denies the Father and the Son.
text_cn: 谁是撒谎的呢？岂不是那否认耶稣为默西亚的吗？那否认父和子的，这人便是假基督。

text_en: No one who denies the Son has the Father; everyone who confesses the Son has the Father also.
text_cn: 凡否认子的，也否认父；那明认子的，也有父。

text_en: Let what you heard from the beginning abide in you. If what you heard from the beginning abides in you, then you will abide in the Son and in the Father.
text_cn: 至于你们，应把从起初所听见的，存留在你们内；如果你们从起初所听见的，存留在你们内，你们必存留在子和父内。

text_en: And this is what he has promised us, eternal life.
text_cn: 这就是他给我们所预许的恩惠：即永远的生命。

text_en: I write these things to you concerning those who would deceive you.
text_cn: 这些就是我关于迷惑你们的人，给你们所写的。

text_en: As for you, the anointing that you received from him abides in you, and so you do not need anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you about all things, and is true and is not a lie, and just as it has taught you, abide in him.
text_cn: 至于你们，你们由他所领受的傅油，常存在你们内，你们就不需要谁教训你们，而是有他的傅油教训你们一切。这傅油是真实的，决不虚假，所以这傅油怎样教训你们，你们就怎样存留在他内。

text_en: And now, little children, abide in him, so that when he is revealed we may have confidence and not be put to shame before him at his coming.
text_cn: 现在，孩子们，你们常存在他内罢！为的是当他显现时，我们可以放心大胆，在他来临时，不至于在他面前蒙羞。

text_en: If you know that he is righteous, you may be sure that everyone who does right has been born of him.
text_cn: 你们既然知道他是正义的，就该知道凡履行正义的，都是由他而生的。
